data: This interdisciplinary course starts from an introduction to psychophysics with its definitions, historical background and its intersection with neuroscience, psychology, physics and other interwoven disciplines. Examples from every day and real-life instances will make it more interesting. Adopting an interactive approach, this course will provide an overview of human sensory systems like vision, hearing, touch, taste, and smell and their neural basis. The students will learn about difference between the sensation and perception, responses and their qualitative and quantitative responses to various stimuli. As this course includes the experimental and data analysis aspects, students will not only learn about the data organization but also about its visualization and analysis.
